Photography

[I work in Lightroom, Photoshop and with a DSLR]

Over the years, I’ve developed a deep passion for photography, particularly through capturing people with a surrealistic lens. I love the idea that with a camera, a computer, and a few creative tools, I can bring my imagination to life and transform everyday moments into something extraordinary.

Projects

Dreams

Photographic Sculptures

Dreams (2020) explores the transformative nature of dreams through surrealist portrait photography. Using laser cutting and traditional portraiture, it creates a dreamlike atmosphere with suspended 3D portraits. The project symbolizes themes of space, love, and peace, enhanced by carefully crafted costumes, props, and makeup.

Blossom Bonds: Portraits of Friends

Photographic Series

Similar to friendships in my life, nature possess the remarkable ability to heal, rejuvenate,and uplift my spirit. They serve as constant reminder of the beauty that surrounds us.
